page.title: Tailwind CSS - Rapidly build modern websites without ever leaving your HTML.

root.name: Tailwind CSS - Rapidly build modern websites without ever leaving your HTML.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Rapidly build modern websites without ever leaving your HTML.

children.name: p
children.characters: A utility-first CSS framework packed with classes like flex, pt-4, text-center and rotate-90 that can be composed to build any design, directly in your markup.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Tailwind is supported by incredible partners and sponsors who make it possible for a team of talented designers and engineers to maintain the framework full-time.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Tailwind is unapologetically modern, and takes advantage of all the latest and greatest CSS features to make the developer experience as enjoyable as possible.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Okay, it’s not exactly cutting edge, but just throw a screen size in front of literally any utility to apply it at a specific breakpoint.

children.name: Text
children.characters: This sunny and spacious room is for those traveling light and looking for a comfy and cozy place to lay their head for a night...

children.name: Text
children.characters: What’s a website these days without a few backdrop blurs? Keep stacking filters until your designer asks you to please, please stop.

children.name: p
children.characters: If you’re not a fan of burning your retinas, just stick dark: in front of any color to apply it in dark mode.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Customizing your theme is as simple as creating a few CSS variables.

children.name: Text
children.characters: The color palette now uses more vibrant wide gamut colors without you needing to understand what any of that even means.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Using grid utilities directly in your HTML makes it so much easier to reason about complex layouts.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Transitions that work the way you'd expect — throw a few utilities on an element and you're in business.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Tailwind uses CSS layers so you don’t have to worry about specificity issues.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Supporting multiple language text directions is no longer a nightmare.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Tag an element as a container to let children adapt to changes in its size.

children.name: Text
children.characters: No need to remember that complicated gradient syntax — create silky-smooth gradients with just a few utility classes.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Our next-generation rendering engine delivers unmatched speed and efficiency, empowering creators to push boundaries like never before.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Sometimes two dimensions aren’t enough. Scale, rotate, and translate any element in 3D space to add a touch of depth.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Tailwind automatically removes all unused CSS when building for production, which means your final CSS bundle is the smallest it could possibly be. In fact, most Tailwind projects ship less than 10kB of CSS to the client.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Build whatever you want, without touching your CSS file.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Because Tailwind is so low-level, it never encourages you to design the same site twice. Some of your favorite sites are built with Tailwind, and you probably had no idea.
